mapper.select: SELECT fs.stack_id AS stackId, s.stack_name AS stackName, s.category AS category, fs.stack_level AS stackLevel, fs.stack_year AS stackYear FROM freelancer_skills fs JOIN stacks s ON s.stack_id = fs.stack_id WHERE fs.freelancer_id = #{freelancerId} AND s.category = #{category} ORDER BY s.stack_name ASC
mapper.insert:
